statement: Every finite outer torus subgroup isomorphic to V4 or D8 has an actual homomorphic lift to Aut(Fhat2) with its prescribed quotient labels. A V4 subgroup has exactly three F-conjugacy classes of full sections when either negative involution acts as the identity modulo two, and exactly one otherwise. A D8 subgroup has exactly one F-conjugacy class of full sections. Every full-section normalizer is the direct product of the section with its full fixed group, whose mod-two first cohomology vanishes. Together with the preceding prime and cyclic-four results, every finite two-subgroup lifts.
depends_on: D46 three positive-involution section classes with vanishing fixed-group mod-two first cohomology and projectivity lifting argument; D50 finite two-subgroup types and signs; D53 unique cyclic-four section class and vanishing full fixed-group mod-two first cohomology; D55 positive-involution homology; D27 torsion-free finite-index cohomological dimension criterion; full Brown restriction theorem A-KochloukovaZalesskii2007

depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The full centre-free extension is the displayed Aut(F) inverse image. The quotients by the chosen finite normal subgroups retain the exact embedded fixed-group kernels. Their finite inverse images inject into the prescribed outer V4 or D8, proving the asserted isomorphism type rather than assuming it.
notes: For V4 the affine action on the three positive-involution section points has three fixed classes when its linear part is identity modulo two and one otherwise. For D8 the unique cyclic-four class is invariant. In each normalizer quotient J the kernel C has C^(2)=1, so J^(2)=C2. Projectivity rules out torsion-freeness of J and supplies an involution. Its full finite preimage injects into the specified outer group and is a section. Brown restriction on J then gives exactly one C-conjugacy class and vanishing mod-two first cohomology of its fixed group. Counting the invariant classes gives the stated full section counts. Geometric conjugacy and a free-product recognition of the complete extension are not asserted. The executed finite certificate is code/part_a/torus_two_group_lifts_d57.py.
